items.performance: One review per employee per period: self rating, the reporting manager's rating (from the employee record), HR finalises; the scale, periods and PRG bands are config/performance.json.
items.awards: Recognition register; an award dated in a month counts for the 'Award received' points rule.
items.points-scores: Employees ranked by net points from the ledger for a period; Auto-apply writes the month's rule-based rows once, from attendance, awards and passed tests.
items.points-ledger: Every points row with its note — auto rows say 'Auto: event × count @ points = total', manual rows are typed here.
items.points-rules: What each event is worth (negative deducts), per company or ALL; the amounts live only on these rows.
items.tests: Employees take MCQ tests from the question bank and are scored on the server: marks ÷ total as a whole percent, compared exactly with the pass mark.
items.test-results: Every attempt with marks, percent and pass / fail.
items.test-reports: Pass rate per test and per department as an exact fraction with the working.
items.attrition: Joiners and leavers per month from DOJ and exit date; rate = leavers ÷ average headcount, exact, with the working.
items.kb: Topics every employee can read, by category and role.
items.training-programs: The training catalogue: mode, mandatory, validity.
items.training-records: Who was assigned and who completed which programme, with score and expiry.
items.training-content: Subjects and modules under a programme with hours and the material.
items.code-of-conduct: The current version's text with a one-click acknowledgement per employee per version; HR sees who has and has not.
items.policies: Versioned policy documents with owner, effective, board-approval and review-due dates.
items.helpdesk: Employees raise tickets and see only their own; HR sets priority, assignee, status and a reply.
